programme.title: 成名之旅 #9
programme.desc: 訪問惠妮休斯頓所演的《護花傾情》導演米克傑克遜、音樂家榮連西、《傳教士之妻》製作人艾略特雅培等人。.

programme.title: 成名之旅 #8
programme.desc: 訪問湯姆漢克斯所演的《盜海狙擊》製作人丹拿般力堤、《紅粉聯盟》製作人艾略特雅培、好友兼演員佐治麥奎亞等人。.

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #2
programme.desc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部。.

programme.title: 俯瞰義大利 #3
programme.desc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山、偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家。它們就是迷人的義大利島國。.

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #3
programme.desc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在新西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作。.

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #4
programme.desc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界。.

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #5

programme.desc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾開始教導第一批空手道學生,他懷疑自己是否能接替宮城先生的衣缽。在一個意想不到的來源幫助下,強尼發明了一些邪道訓練方法。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾全力以赴為宮城道招募新生。強尼反省生命中一些重要的關係,並以自己的方式回應丹尼爾的努力宣傳。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾再次嘗試推廣宮城道,並以熟悉的方式獲得指導。強尼對克里斯的背景越發生疑。一名新的眼鏡蛇道場學生挑戰米格爾並與艾莎成為朋友,而羅比則重溫寧願忘記的過去。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力幫助新生學習。米格爾交了新友,而強尼則嘗試修復一段關係。兩個道場之間的張力已達到臨界點。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #6
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的學生們上了如何克服怨恨的一課。強尼離開道場一段時間,而克里斯則發揮他的影響力。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #7
programme.desc: 為了讓學生們做好準備,丹尼爾嘗試一些新的訓練方法。米格爾活學活用。強尼做出一個影響眼鏡蛇道場既艱難但關鍵的決定。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #8
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力與阿曼達修補關係,而強尼則打開約會應用程式的大門。米格爾、薩曼莎、羅比和朵利的相遇讓事情變得複雜起來。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #9
programme.desc: 強尼小心翼翼地嘗試不大會成功的戀愛,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則享受浪漫的約會夜。嘗試讓兩個道場的學生聚會卻適得其反,青少年間的敵意不斷升級。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #10
programme.desc: 這是西谷高中開學的第一天,但​​兩個道場之間的張力並沒有隨著夏天的結束而緩和。丹尼爾和強尼之間的競爭到了白熱化階段。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #1
programme.desc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤。丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為「西谷高中大亂鬥」的後續動盪不安。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比。米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾前往日本洽談重要會議,重回沖繩,尋找能讓事業與人生重回正軌的啟示。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #5
programme.desc: 在沖繩,丹尼爾重逢舊友與舊敵,意外獲得新的領悟。同時,兩大道館的宿怨持續升溫。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #6
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼打造完美的社交媒體形象;克里斯積極招募新成員,丹尼爾與阿曼達試圖關閉眼鏡蛇道館。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾陪伴受創的珊,修復父女關係。強尼計劃成立新道館,卻苦於想不到一個酷炫的名字。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #8
programme.desc: 得知本年度全谷空手道大賽被取消後,三位師父齊聚市議會,努力爭取比賽繼續舉行。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #9
programme.desc: 聖誕節將至,愛情與和解的氣息瀰漫。丹尼爾與米格爾找到共同點,眼鏡蛇學徒展開一場秘密行動。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #10
programme.desc: 聖誕派對上舊傷復發、恩怨再起。克里斯的學生發動暴力襲擊,新的背叛與同盟由此誕生。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #1
programme.desc: 強尼與丹尼爾合併道館,但彼此截然不同的教學風格立刻產生衝突。克里斯試圖說服一名前搭檔重返眼鏡蛇道館。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #2
programme.desc: 強尼學習防守策略,丹尼爾則嘗試主動進攻。阿曼達直面托莉。新來的肯尼在學校遭到霸凌。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #3
programme.desc: 在羅比的鼓勵下,肯尼試圖成為眼鏡蛇道館的學生;同時,強尼鼓勵珊相信自己,勇敢踏出一步。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #4
programme.desc: 克里斯將泰瑞帶回眼鏡蛇道館,但這位舊夥伴並不想重蹈覆轍。強尼對丹尼爾指導米格爾感到心生嫉妒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #5
programme.desc: 當強尼與丹尼爾同意進行一場「勝者全拿」的師父對決時,他們的道館——以及脆弱的同盟——瀕臨瓦解。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #6
programme.desc: 即將到來的比賽規則出現重大變動,強尼急忙為「鷹牙道館」尋找新學員。托莉不得不向拉魯索一家請求幫助。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾邀請安東尼加入宮城道,卻發現自己其實並不如想像中了解兒子。米格爾得知強尼與卡門之間的真相。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #8
programme.desc: 米格爾與珊期待參加青少年舞會,卻因另一對情侶的突然出現而生變。泰瑞將強尼引誘至一個熟悉的地方。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #9
programme.desc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大賽正式展開,多個道館為總冠軍而戰,同時清算私人恩怨。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #10
programme.desc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。.

programme.desc: 當強尼與丹尼爾同意進行一場「勝者全拿」的師父對決時,他們的道館——以及脆弱的同盟——瀕臨瓦解。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #6
programme.desc: 即將到來的比賽規則出現重大變動,強尼急忙為「鷹牙道館」尋找新學員。托莉不得不向拉魯索一家請求幫助。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼爾邀請安東尼加入宮城道,卻發現自己其實並不如想像中了解兒子。米格爾得知強尼與卡門之間的真相。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #8
programme.desc: 米格爾與珊期待參加青少年舞會,卻因另一對情侶的突然出現而生變。泰瑞將強尼引誘至一個熟悉的地方。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #9
programme.desc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大賽正式展開,多個道館為總冠軍而戰,同時清算私人恩怨。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 4 #10
programme.desc: 比賽以震撼結局落幕,後續影響讓所有參賽者措手不及,兩位冠軍的未來充滿變數。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #1
programme.desc: 強尼勞倫斯在輸掉全谷空手道錦標賽34年後,決定重開眼鏡蛇道場,而他學校的對手丹尼爾拉魯索則經營著一家成功的汽車公司。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾沮喪地發現全新的眼鏡蛇道場已經開業。強尼瞭解到他的道場真正開始教學前必須通過幾項安全要求。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #3
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼在網上宣傳眼鏡蛇道場。丹尼爾同意在萬聖節舞會上擔任監護人,以便可以看顧女兒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #4
programme.desc: 羅比與父親關係緊張。強尼因米格爾受傷而計畫關閉眼鏡蛇道場。薩曼莎和凱勒的關係跌至谷底。被破壞的廣告板讓丹尼爾繃緊。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #5
programme.desc: 眼鏡蛇道場接收第二位學生。丹尼爾有一個複雜的計劃來報復強尼。米格爾在午休時為捍衛薩曼莎而對抗凱勒。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #6
programme.desc: 強尼的道場課吸引一群不合的人,而他心懷不軌的兒子羅比則找到一份新工作。薩曼莎在科學課上結識一位新朋友。丹尼爾激發了一個意想不到的人對空手道的興趣。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #7
programme.desc: 強尼得知眼鏡蛇道場被禁止參加全谷錦標賽後跟市議會對質。米格爾約會薩曼莎。羅比向丹尼爾學習,而他的夥伴則策劃搶劫拉魯索汽車公司。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #8
programme.desc: 強尼為他的眼鏡蛇道場學生準備下一屆全谷空手道錦標賽,他也反過來受啟發去改過自新。丹尼爾還不知道他新學生的背景。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #9
programme.desc: 路易的魯莽行為逼使強尼和丹尼爾回憶往事。眼鏡蛇道場學生密謀對受歡迎的孩子進行報復。米格爾對薩曼莎慢慢失去耐性。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 #10
programme.desc: 今天是2018年度全谷空手道錦標賽,眼鏡蛇道場決心取勝。羅比以獨立人士登記。一個舊臉孔回歸。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼鏡蛇道場贏得18歲以下全谷空手道錦標賽冠軍後,強尼開始質疑自己的道場哲學,並與他一位故人打交道。丹尼爾尋找正確的方式來應付眼鏡蛇道場的統治。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾開始教導第一批空手道學生,他懷疑自己是否能接替宮城先生的衣缽。在一個意想不到的來源幫助下,強尼發明了一些邪道訓練方法。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾全力以赴為宮城道招募新生。強尼反省生命中一些重要的關係,並以自己的方式回應丹尼爾的努力宣傳。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾再次嘗試推廣宮城道,並以熟悉的方式獲得指導。強尼對克里斯的背景越發生疑。一名新的眼鏡蛇道場學生挑戰米格爾並與艾莎成為朋友,而羅比則重溫寧願忘記的過去。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力幫助新生學習。米格爾交了新友,而強尼則嘗試修復一段關係。兩個道場之間的張力已達到臨界點。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #6
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的學生們上了如何克服怨恨的一課。強尼離開道場一段時間,而克里斯則發揮他的影響力。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #7
programme.desc: 為了讓學生們做好準備,丹尼爾嘗試一些新的訓練方法。米格爾活學活用。強尼做出一個影響眼鏡蛇道場既艱難但關鍵的決定。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #8
programme.desc: 丹尼爾努力與阿曼達修補關係,而強尼則打開約會應用程式的大門。米格爾、薩曼莎、羅比和朵利的相遇讓事情變得複雜起來。.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 2 #9
programme.desc: 強尼小心翼翼地嘗試不大會成功的戀愛,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則享受浪漫的約會夜。嘗試讓兩個道場的學生聚會卻適得其反,青少年間的敵意不斷升級。.

programme.desc: 深受奧斯卡和緹娜夏信賴的瓦爾托,曾在某段歷史中擔任法爾薩斯的魔法師長並經歷了無數次人生。在某次強國塔伊利之神,伊力提魯迪亞襲擊法爾薩斯而讓他痛失摯愛蜜菈莉絲後,他就使用艾爾特利亞試圖改寫歷史。防備著露琪亞的緹娜夏前往瑪葛達魯西亞進行調查。.

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #23
programme.desc: 瑪葛達魯西亞和鐸洱達爾終於開戰。當緹娜夏對上露琪亞,奧斯卡趕來傳達瓦爾托提供的情報。露琪亞體內的是瑪葛達魯西亞的國王,露克芮札的靈魂則被關在「忘卻之鏡」中。將露琪亞交給奧斯卡對付,緹娜夏則去破壞「忘卻之鏡」,但這場戰鬥的終結不過是段插曲。.

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #24
programme.desc: 瓦爾托為了避免摯愛,蜜菈莉絲的靈魂因歷史走到盡頭而被解體,拿鐸洱達爾當籌碼逼緹娜夏破壞艾爾特利亞。緹娜夏雖明白魔法球為瓦爾托帶來的痛苦和其影響力,仍感到猶豫不已。她將後事託付給奧斯卡後抱著藍色魔法球跳入無言之湖,並回到她最幸福的那一刻….

programme.title: 海賊王 #13
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #5
programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司麗茲的訓練下終於獲得了信心。為了使莉莉墮落,他開始採取行動。對於以閃閃動人的帥氣模式誘惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以軟萌女主角的模式反擊。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻擊,並逐一閃避過去……處於壓倒性劣勢的莉莉,決定要孤注一擲。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因為她腦裡全都是昨晚和阿久津之間所發生的事。不勝睡魔的她,在上課時不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至還出現在了她的睡夢中。在這場如戀愛遊戲般的夢境中,她認為她或許能找到攻略阿久津的線索……莉莉打算推進遊戲中的故事,然而…….

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #9

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #3
programme.desc: 造訪書店的白石好心地想將被亂放的書歸位,但拿到手上才發現是色情書刊。在他動搖時,有位女性店員對路人男的白石搭話。之後在冬日的某天,久保傳訊息給白石,邀他一起出去玩。兩人決定好日期,白石再次確認月曆時發現當天居然是12月25日的聖誕節。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #4
programme.desc: 在2月14日的情人節,校內男女都散發出坐立難安的氛圍,對路人男的白石來說當天本該是與他無緣的平日。然而他入座後卻驚訝地發現桌子裡居然有一片心型的巧克力餅乾!白石忍不住重新確認了五次,頭還撞到桌子,此時久保出現在他面前。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #5
programme.desc: 在3月的某一天,白石注意到3月14日在月曆被標記為「白色情人節」,讓他想起了情人節在桌子中發現的巧克力餅乾。平時容易被店員忽略的白石下定決心購買一份情人節回禮。在白色情人節當天,他將久保叫到走廊。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #6
programme.desc: 某天白石身後的一位女孩撿到他弄掉的手帕,叫住了他。平時弄掉物品經常會被直接無視的白石對此感到不可思議。他後來偶然得知那女孩是久保的堂妹沙貴、在書店遇到的女店員是久保的姊姊明菜。在另一天,白石在上學時遲到,他察覺從教室出來的久保樣子有些奇怪。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #5
programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司麗茲的訓練下終於獲得了信心。為了使莉莉墮落,他開始採取行動。對於以閃閃動人的帥氣模式誘惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以軟萌女主角的模式反擊。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻擊,並逐一閃避過去……處於壓倒性劣勢的莉莉,決定要孤注一擲。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因為她腦裡全都是昨晚和阿久津之間所發生的事。不勝睡魔的她,在上課時不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至還出現在了她的睡夢中。在這場如戀愛遊戲般的夢境中,她認為她或許能找到攻略阿久津的線索……莉莉打算推進遊戲中的故事,然而…….

programme.title: 海賊王 #13
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #3
programme.desc: 由於已離婚的妻子死去,昌幸遭警方懷疑是殺人凶手。在死者的手掌上還發現對他不利的死亡訊息。唯一能證明清白和不在場證明的證人只有案發時陪在他身邊的雪女。然而妖怪無法向警方提供證詞,於是雪女決定依靠琴子的力量尋找真兇。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #4
programme.desc: 琴子在交織真實與虛構的過程中逐漸逼近案件核心,並聲稱知道真兇身分!昌幸已脫離殺人嫌疑所帶來的危急情況,她進一步表示死亡訊息是真兇為了嫁禍給昌幸而寫下的,他能否接受逐漸明朗化的殘酷真相?

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #5
programme.desc: 六花瞞著琴子和九郎獨自搬到公寓居住。只帶著一個包包,而且沒有保證人的她租到一間連續三人自殺的凶宅。房東的紺野和幸目睹遭車撞飛卻毫髮無傷、對凶宅也毫不動搖的六花後感到不可思議,於是向她詢問搬家理由以及自殺房客們的事。.

programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司麗茲的訓練下終於獲得了信心。為了使莉莉墮落,他開始採取行動。對於以閃閃動人的帥氣模式誘惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以軟萌女主角的模式反擊。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻擊,並逐一閃避過去……處於壓倒性劣勢的莉莉,決定要孤注一擲。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因為她腦裡全都是昨晚和阿久津之間所發生的事。不勝睡魔的她,在上課時不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至還出現在了她的睡夢中。在這場如戀愛遊戲般的夢境中,她認為她或許能找到攻略阿久津的線索……莉莉打算推進遊戲中的故事,然而…….

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #5
programme.desc: 在3月的某一天,白石注意到3月14日在月曆被標記為「白色情人節」,讓他想起了情人節在桌子中發現的巧克力餅乾。平時容易被店員忽略的白石下定決心購買一份情人節回禮。在白色情人節當天,他將久保叫到走廊。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #6
programme.desc: 某天白石身後的一位女孩撿到他弄掉的手帕,叫住了他。平時弄掉物品經常會被直接無視的白石對此感到不可思議。他後來偶然得知那女孩是久保的堂妹沙貴、在書店遇到的女店員是久保的姊姊明菜。在另一天,白石在上學時遲到,他察覺從教室出來的久保樣子有些奇怪。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #5
programme.desc: 六花瞞著琴子和九郎獨自搬到公寓居住。只帶著一個包包,而且沒有保證人的她租到一間連續三人自殺的凶宅。房東的紺野和幸目睹遭車撞飛卻毫髮無傷、對凶宅也毫不動搖的六花後感到不可思議,於是向她詢問搬家理由以及自殺房客們的事。.

programme.title: 海賊王 #15
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。.

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #13
programme.desc: 烏野高中的下一個對手是角川排球隊,當中有名身高高達201公分的球員。.

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #1
programme.desc: 花笑凜子在遭人推落後離奇死亡,轉生成小說中的登場人物——麥米倫家的千金萊利娜。萊利娜在小說中是一名配角,即將被未婚夫布魯克斯毒害身亡。凜子為了改變將死的命運,便主動向擁有極大權力的「第一王位繼承人」努爾公爵提出一筆交易。.

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #2
programme.desc: 為了正式締結契約,萊利娜獨自前往溫奈特家。她以努爾其實暗中持有新舊貴族對立下的王牌「玉璽」這項情報,試圖動搖對方來作為交易籌碼,但努爾卻不為所動。就在交易即將陷入不成立的危機之時,一張擺放突兀的棋盤映入萊利娜的眼簾。.

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #9
programme.desc: 寒假期間,高木同學和西片一起去看電影。兩人在電影開始前進行夾娃娃比賽…西片能比高木同學早一步夾到獎品嗎…?

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #10
programme.desc: 西片和高木同學一起去新年參拜,並進行今年的第一場比賽,而比賽方法和勝負結果究竟如何?高木同學在新年參拜時許下的願望又是…? 收錄「雪人」、「過年」、「商量」等四個章節。.

programme.title: 海賊王 #15
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。.

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #3
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了進行新娘修行而住進溫奈特家中。兩人試圖偽裝成相愛的未婚夫妻,卻連要如何稱呼彼此都遭遇到許多困難。雖然理智上知道這只不過是一段虛假的關係,並不需要事事做到完美,但萊利娜仍是一一完成接連強加於她身上的各項新娘修行任務。.

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #4
programme.desc: 萊利娜與努爾來到舞會會場,兩人的婚約在貴族之間備受矚目。萊利娜為了讓努爾欠自己人情,受其請託,正策劃著與艾利提爾侯爵夫人單獨會面,小說中的惡女角色薇薇安卻突然現身。不僅如此,一名盯上萊利娜的可疑人物也悄然現身。.

programme.desc: 萊利娜為了進行新娘修行而住進溫奈特家中。兩人試圖偽裝成相愛的未婚夫妻,卻連要如何稱呼彼此都遭遇到許多困難。雖然理智上知道這只不過是一段虛假的關係,並不需要事事做到完美,但萊利娜仍是一一完成接連強加於她身上的各項新娘修行任務。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。.

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因為她腦裡全都是昨晚和阿久津之間所發生的事。不勝睡魔的她,在上課時不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至還出現在了她的睡夢中。在這場如戀愛遊戲般的夢境中,她認為她或許能找到攻略阿久津的線索……莉莉打算推進遊戲中的故事,然而…….

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #7
programme.desc: 莉莉在與「素體」的戰鬥中精疲力竭,並失去了意識。阿久津抱起了她,並把她送回了她的房間。阿久津本欲離去,卻被意識模糊的莉莉抓住衣角,無法動彈。無奈之下,他只好坐在房間讀角落。過了一陣子,莉莉醒了過來。她發現阿久津已經睡著了,於是她便悄悄地接近了他的身邊。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #7
programme.desc: 白石同學順利撐過期末考期間,沒被沒收遊戲機。然而第三學期一旦結束便會重新分班,「自己被久保同學發現的日子可能會迎來尾聲」,白石同學開始有這種寂寞的心情。而到葉月家借住一晚的久保同學在談及分班話題時,腦中也自然浮現白石同學的身影。.

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #8
programme.desc: 明天準備賞花的久保同學、沙貴、明菜三人到超市採買,偶遇帶著誠太的白石同學。久保同學像平時那樣向兩人搭話,而誠太竟對沙貴一見鍾情,明菜見狀便邀白石同學與誠太一起去賞花。然而在隔天舉辦的賞花宴會上,喝醉的明菜掀起了一陣風波。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。.

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #7
programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪們的委託下前往拜訪多惠。她察覺這尊一到夜晚就會隨機電死大量魚群的木偶身上寄宿著落於本地的「某異物」之力,具備與世間常理相悖的神祕力量。琴子等人立即著手計劃消滅木偶,然而它身上卻隱藏著一個祕密。.

programme.desc: A talent competition where an array of performers -- from singers and dancers, to comedians and novelty acts -- vie for a $1 million cash prize.

programme.title: Breathtaking Landscapes of Spain
programme.desc: Spain is a land of contrasts, a place where nature shows us its beauty with a wide variety of landscapes: lush forests, arid deserts and ravines, spectacular coastlines, amazing caves, cool mountain landscapes…Breathtaking Landscapes of Spain takes the viewer on a journey all over the country to discover its most beautiful and surprising corners. Jumping from one region to another, 9 Episodes will show us 80 natural spaces of amazing beauty.

programme.title: 尋找克莉絲蒂足跡
programme.desc: Alan Carr is on a literary journey of a lifetime to discover his favourite childhood author Agatha Christie and two of her most beloved characters, Miss Marple and Hercule Poirot.

programme.title: 北國三人行
programme.desc: PEOPLE OF THE NORTH, discover the untamed beauty of Northern Europe in our captivating second season as our intrepid hosts venture through Norway and beyond. Embark on a mesmerizing journey with 'People of the North,' where rugged fishing hamlets and breathtaking vistas of Scandinavia await. Guided by the seasoned Norwegian presenter, Arne Hjeltnes, and the acclaimed Distiller Stig Bareksten, alongside Swedish Chef Frida Ronge or Norwegian Chef Sigrid Henjum. Immerse yourself in the essence of the North and the rich tapestry of Scandinavian culture as our hosts engage with the resilient souls who call these remote lands home. Each episode unveils a tapestry of narratives and customs, granting viewers insights into the Northern European way of life.

programme.title: Mark Moriarty：大廚教路
programme.desc: In Cook Like a Chef, award-winning chef Mark Moriarty invites viewers to rethink the way they cook at home. Forget the notion that great food demands endless ingredients or hours in the kitchen. With a handful of core ingredients, a well-stocked pantry, and a few pro tips, Mark shows how anyone can create restaurant-worthy meals in their own kitchen.

programme.title: Klincus
programme.desc: Klincus befriends the tiny inhabitants of the treetop village Frondosa in Bosco Grande forest. He protects them from industrialist Graylock's deforestation plans, discovering his abilities while learning life lessons.

programme.title: Camp Snoopy
programme.desc: After discovering their troop is in danger of disbanding, Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts set off to the Great Outdoors to earn their performance badges, with the Beagle Scout Manual as their guide. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown and friends enjoy their summer at Camp Spring Lake, crossing paths with Snoopy as they experience everything camp and the outdoors have to offer.

programme.title: Miniheroes of the Forest
programme.desc: Any time is a good time to play: Gaston the Bear, Juliette the Owl, Jade the Fox and Gabin the Rabbit can't wait to find out what super adventures the forest has in store for them. To accomplish their incredible missions, the MiniHeroes need little their Cloak, Mask and Mega Powers! And after all, the greatest adventure of all is friendship.

programme.title: Team Mekbots: Animal Rescue
programme.desc: Follows four animal-loving kids from around the world who use their tech skills to create giant Mekbots, each inspired by a different animal.

programme.title: 雲端對談 第四系列
programme.desc: 香港大學外科學系講座教授（移植腫瘤學及免疫學），香港大學外科學系臨床與轉化實驗室主任，器官移植與再生實驗室主任，肝移植與肝癌實驗室主任。領先研發技術「肝立方」，透過三維生物打印仿製病患肝臟，幫助病患快速評估各類傳統藥物和新興療法的功效和副作用，幫助醫生作出精準診療決策.

programme.desc: This brand new programme will chart the evolution of Prince Edward, examining how his childhood and upbringing differed to that of his siblings and how this cemented his special place in the family as Philips favourite. Using archive and interviews with historians, royal insiders and journalists. We’ll reflect on the key moments throughout Edwards life that have shaped and influenced him, from his university days and stint in the Marines, to marriage and fatherhood, his working life and so much more. We’ll unravel his most intimate moments to determine the effect it had on the Prince and his path in life. As Edward now embarks on a new role, taking over the title of Duke of Edinburgh from his beloved father, he has big shoes to step into and big expectations to meet. Throughout this film we’ll compare father and son closely to learn about their unbreakable bond and how the memory and legacy of the late Prince Phillip now lives on through his youngest son.

He’ll discover the history and culture of the country’s diverse regions through food.It’s a road trip like no other, stopping at 20 destinations travelling anti clockwise from San Sebastian to Girona through the ever-changing landscapes to search out key ingredients, sample the fine dining offerings, rustic eateries and traditional recipes that make Spain one of the most exciting countries in the world for gastronomy. Along the way he'll be setting up his mobile kitchen against backdrops of stunning scenery. He’ll also be taking up residency in a gorgeous mountaintop villa as his Spanish ‘home from home’ kitchen to cook a mouth-watering 80 new recipes.

programme.title: 世一鐵路導賞團
programme.desc: Rolling past snow-capped peaks, fairy-tale castles, and breathtaking natural wonders, The World’s Most Scenic Railway Journeys is an unforgettable ride through some of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From New Zealand, Sri Lanka, and the sweeping Scottish Highlands, to a Mexican odyssey, an Arctic expedition, and a luxurious African safari, it’s a breathtaking adventure. Along the way, meet the engineers who keep these trains running and the many characters who work, travel, and live along these exotic and far-flung routes. And while an airplane is certainly the quickest route to any destination, nothing compares to an epic train expedition where it’s always the journey that counts.

programme.title: 異國風情畫
programme.desc: 阿 Dee 不滿被 ERROR 三子撇甩，要求加開一集，於是他們四人便終於合體，被安排北上。他們會在神秘導遊帶領下，做盡香港人北上會做的正經事，包括玩高卡車、食齋、食中菜、還有食牛歡喜.

programme.title: 執屋
programme.desc: 阿Kit初為人母，喜愛購買不同禮物贈送予親友，加上與丈夫都是童心未泯，因此滿屋盡是漫畫、影片、小說、毛公仔等等，多雜物的程度是工人姐姐在自己房間的空間就只得一張床！空說希望解決自己家中問題的同時，又不願意斷捨離，究竟一班主持會有多頭痕呢.

programme.title: 踢館
programme.desc: 今集所挑戰的餐廳是以海鮮菜式而聞名港九，不少識飲識食之人都專程到訪幫襯，更會必食今集的招牌菜。至於今次的挑戰者正好對海鮮食材素有研究，加上在試煮時得到主持大廚Jacques的充分肯定，令挑戰者信心大增！到底今集能否成功踢館.

programme.title: 妳想生活
programme.sub-title: 壁畫女生 chill 寫意
programme.desc: 為了夢想，90後女生 Carol 甘願放棄高薪厚職，即使捱更抵夜、日曬雨淋都在所不辭，為著就是要成就一幅幅巨型壁畫，吸睛打卡位遍布中西區。小小女生，如何用畫筆填上精彩人生.

programme.title: NBA 常規賽 -丹佛金塊 對 奧克拉荷馬雷霆
programme.desc: 丹佛金塊 對 奧克拉荷馬雷霆.

programme.title: 單車踩爆日本 -落山極限挑戰-大山
programme.desc: 魔鬼教練陳安立 (Brian) 爆 SEED，女神蘇皓兒 (Chloe) 受傷了！今集嚟到單車仔 Brian 最期待的鳥取大山，去挑戰一條風景最靚落山單車路線，好勝女神 Chloe 新手上陣就要跟住 Brian 上山下海，中途仲要落大雨飢寒交迫，黑仔女神零度炒車，一雙白滑長腿有無事呀？.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集邀請晚安莉莉以及ToNick擔任嘉賓，向大家恭賀新春！晚安莉莉與ToNick在年初六聯同五位中樂樂手，為大家帶來一場激情四溢的音樂盛宴以及分享喜悅和祝福！本集亦邀請到全新男團ZPOT帶來歌曲《ZPOTLIGHT!》，樂迷切勿錯過！本集亦繼續會有 「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲.

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.desc: 藝術家沈君怡擅長以山水畫探討社會與時間，並破格地用銀箔演繹傳統畫作中的「虛」。今集，主持將帶大家了解她的創作意念，並跟她學習繪畫山石與貼銀箔的工序，感受傳統與當代元素碰撞出的新火花.

programme.title: 日本GAO芯假期
programme.desc: 二人前往東京著名文青區—清澄白河，踏著單車，享受漫畫中的日本。芯駖初次學習如何製作手沖咖啡和Gao一起享受咖啡風味。晚上更約了朋友前往大黑停車場，和名車共舞.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.desc: 《廚神奶奶是你媽》冠軍戰今晚開始，真正的「廚神奶奶」即將誕生！3對奶奶也作戰 Mode 上身，其新抱亦出盡奶力協助奶奶！郭玥彤 (Celia) 指奶奶梁綺芳 (Connie) 帶了半個廚房到場比賽，包括自備了4個筲箕、刀、鉸剪、2個煲、1隻鑊，非常誇張！ 江若琳 (Elanne) 是三位新抱中，廚藝比較弱的一位，所以奶奶黎碧芬 (Peggy) 就主力落廚，Elanne 就幫忙做預備功夫，最難得是奶奶一點也不介意！ 有亞洲女廚神之稱的 May Chow 表示見到大家都煮傳統菜，她很希望了解到幾對組合的創意點，而有開過份子料理餐廳的徐蒨寧 (阿姨) 似乎可以滿足到 May 這方面的要求，究竟阿姨有什麼殺手鐧呢.

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥
programme.sub-title: 嘉賓: 洪嘉豪、程人富、楊安妮 、Isabella 陳海寧、米露迪
programme.desc: 疫情下大家留在家中，不知道有什麼事情可以做？全新節目《MM730 困獸鬥》一眾藝人會在節目內玩不同遊戲，只要贏就可以有獎，但輸就要接受懲罰！到底最後哪一位可以逃出錄影廠？哪一位要接受懲罰呢.

programme.title: 熊熊幫幫團 2
programme.desc: 《熊熊幫幫團 2》講述了大寶二寶和利華組成的「熊熊幫幫團」幫助小朋友解決困難和煩惱的故事。 著重展現孩子們樂於助人、勇敢團結、智慧耐心、富有正義責任等美好成長品格，延續了溫暖、正義、輕鬆、愉快的故事風格。自從上部「熊熊幫幫團」組成後，已經為小鎮居民做了許多好事。 每當響起求助的警報，俏皮的團子、勇敢的大寶、可愛的二寶、機智的利華便會開啟絢麗的魔法通道，第一時間出現在需要幫助的人面前，他們活躍在小鎮和 森林四處，利用奇妙的魔法、聰明的頭腦、趣味的科技發明幫助大家，成為了森林小鎮的守護者，也成為了大家信賴的援手和正面榜樣。 但是，「熊熊幫幫團」即將面臨更多更大的挑戰！ 在幫忙、救援的過程中，他們將會碰到更多性格迥異、有著不同習慣的小朋友，還將遇到各種前所未有的困難和煩惱，「熊熊幫幫團」又會如何幫助大家解決 問題呢.

programme.title: 世界之「趣」
programme.desc: 今集帶大家到位於歐洲地區的斯洛文尼亞！斯洛文尼亞有個湖中央出現一座升天教堂？彩繪蜂箱板竟是展現斯洛文尼亞人的幽默精髓？一起與AI導遊探索吧.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 本周快閃人口
programme.desc: 「本周快閃人口」是一個讓觀眾感受一個另類旅遊的節目，我們將跟隨不同身份的人一同度過一個非凡的周末。這些人包括寵物店的買手、劍擊運動員的家長等等，他們每個人都有自己獨特的放假方式。他們的周末有別於一般人留在香港，而是選擇到海外渡過，當中有人因為偶像，也有人因為減壓而飛到外地。我將跟隨受訪者的「快閃」假期機會深入了解他們，並體驗他們所經歷的獨特周末。每個受訪者以兩集為單位透過主持人的視角，感受到不同人的生活方式觀察他們的在「快閃」當中的苦樂。同時受訪者也會帶領主持人去一些平日常去的地方，例如他們喜歡的咖啡店、偶像應援活動、比賽活動等.

programme.title: 寶礦力水特電解質水 ion water 呈獻: 週六好戲勢: 金雞
programme.desc: 一個風雨交加的晚上，四十歲的阿金(吳君如飾)在銀行櫃員机中心被賊人阿邦(曾志偉飾)持刀行劫，但阿金戶口結餘只得$98.2，無法提款；阿金的$98.2正好反映香港現今經濟疲弱，而阿金一生色情事業，更與香港廿年來的起落息息相關，共同經歷了經濟起飛、中英談判、六四事件、北姑入侵、九七回歸、亞洲金融風暴、禽流感、負資產以至破產浪潮等廿載風風雨雨，時至現今節衣縮食的關頭下，阿金仍與香港共渡時艱，投身「一樓一」自僱行列，與香港市民同唱「獅子山下」.

programme.title: 殭屍100～在成為殭屍前要做的100件事～
足球女將：終極一戰
programme.desc: 經歷6個月的密集訓練，螢花足球隊終於迎來終極一戰。一眾球員在足球路上，曾遇過大比數落敗，亦感受過勝利的喜悅，今次對戰隊伍「佳聯元朗」位列乙組，是多場友賽中實力最強的隊伍，在球迷的注視下，螢花能否迎難而上，交出亮眼的成績表？數月以來，球員們努力爭取正選位置，到底終極一戰誰能成為正選11人.

programme.title: 究竟讀緊乜
programme.desc: 對生命的關懷又何止生與死，人到老年總有許多事需要協助，ERROR繼續在馬偕護專入讀集智慧科技長期照顧科，體驗一日老人照護。今集特別安排一次「長者旅行團」，與六位參與女同學進行面試，了解為何年紀輕輕就投身長者照護工作。幾位同學跳舞、搞笑使盡渾身解數，與ERROR成員組隊，一起設計行程，務求為「長者」帶來一趟輕鬆開心的旅程.

programme.title: 返歸啦俄仔
programme.desc: Ansheles同Ceci兩個好朋友終於有機會一齊去旅行，又嚟到索契呢個渡假勝地，梗係真係渡吓假啦，上山下海是常識吧！今集Ansheles先帶Ceci上山滑雪，喜愛陽光與海灘嘅Ceci招唔招架得住呢？上完雪山，Ansheles帶Ceci去一次海上之旅，體驗索契人嘅海上生活，仲會煮埋野食添，俄羅斯人嘅渡假方式真係好寫意呀.

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul
programme.desc: Kathy和Dixon前往首爾會合狗狗主持Teddy，Teddy盡地主之誼，帶領二人到櫻花秘點散步；為了深入認識這位狗拍檔，二人約會Teddy主人，對方竟然是香港人？因為神祕力量令Dixon犬化，他必須前往弘大狗狗咖啡廳尋找解決辦法.

programme.title: 勁騎26
programme.desc: 今集 Alton 被製作組綁架到未知地方，接受神秘挑戰。呢款車集合技術、膽量、姿態於一身，令 Alton 「顛覆對電單車嘅概念」！上咗一日速成班，佢雄心壯志咁訂下目標，豪言要奔向月球。面對眾人圍觀嘅壓力，究竟自稱「天才車手」嘅王勁會唔會成功.

programme.title: 廚神奶奶是你媽
programme.desc: 《廚神奶奶是你媽》冠軍戰今晚開始，真正的「廚神奶奶」即將誕生！3對奶奶也作戰 Mode 上身，其新抱亦出盡奶力協助奶奶！郭玥彤 (Celia) 指奶奶梁綺芳 (Connie) 帶了半個廚房到場比賽，包括自備了4個筲箕、刀、鉸剪、2個煲、1隻鑊，非常誇張！ 江若琳 (Elanne) 是三位新抱中，廚藝比較弱的一位，所以奶奶黎碧芬 (Peggy) 就主力落廚，Elanne 就幫忙做預備功夫，最難得是奶奶一點也不介意！ 有亞洲女廚神之稱的 May Chow 表示見到大家都煮傳統菜，她很希望了解到幾對組合的創意點，而有開過份子料理餐廳的徐蒨寧 (阿姨) 似乎可以滿足到 May 這方面的要求，究竟阿姨有什麼殺手鐧呢.

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 激鼓除了是一種樂器演奏，更是團隊精神的體現。今集繼續訪問鼓社的創辦人與學生，聽聽他們如何發揮激鼓的精神.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 蕭裕蓓 （bgirl Mirage）8歲時被醫生診斷為全身關節炎，並預計她18歲或會無法走路。然而，她選擇以霹靂舞挑戰宿命，最終跳出香港。今集主持將了解她背後的故事，見證她如何舞出奇蹟.

programme.title: 環保發現號
programme.desc: 結婚是人生大事，新人們都想將婚禮盡善盡美。然而牽涉的物品很多，是否通通都要用完即棄？今集嘉賓將婚禮用品循環再用，聽聽她如何減少浪費.

programme.title: 執屋
programme.desc: 阿Kit初為人母，喜愛購買不同禮物贈送予親友，加上與丈夫都是童心未泯，因此滿屋盡是漫畫、影片、小說、毛公仔等等，多雜物的程度是工人姐姐在自己房間的空間就只得一張床！空說希望解決自己家中問題的同時，又不願意斷捨離，究竟一班主持會有多頭痕呢.

programme.title: 異國風情畫
programme.desc: 阿 Dee 不滿被 ERROR 三子撇甩，要求加開一集，於是他們四人便終於合體，被安排北上。他們會在神秘導遊帶領下，做盡香港人北上會做的正經事，包括玩高卡車、食齋、食中菜、還有食牛歡喜.

programme.title: GO！執！事務所
programme.desc: GO! 執! 事務所表現良好，獲得事主獎勵「免找數瘋狂購物 30 秒」得到甜頭的成員也不敢怠慢，阿橙出動必殺技整理阿 Nick 店舖的大小貨倉，就地取材之餘又 不失美觀。但客服執事阿正不讓阿正專美，以創意爆棚的產品名稱取悅事主..

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 退休後還能重新出發？本集邀請推動長者就業的社企副總裁，以及資深員工，分享如何透過適合的工作，讓長者重拾自信與成就感，開啟職場新篇章.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 袁思偉，香港男子排球代表隊隊長兼二傳手，曾出戰杭州亞運。畢業體育教育系，現任小學體育科主任及排球教練，雙職並行推廣排球運動，勵志故事鼓舞年輕一代.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: No.1戰隊五獸者
programme.sub-title: 恐怖爆現！絲帶在鬼屋裡狂笑

programme.title: 學界Create, Like and Share 第三季
programme.desc: 全新充滿創意與活力的節目《學界Create, Like and Share》， 帶領觀眾深入探索香港各大學校的獨特魅力和多彩生活! 節目不僅聚焦學校的學術成就，更展現學生們的創意才華與日常趣事，讓觀眾感受到校園的創意與活力。每集節目中，校園導遊瑪姬邀請不同學校的學生團隊，展示他們的創意項目、藝術表演及社會服務，令觀眾更加了解學校！你可以透過這個節目一探學校的多樣性，發掘你未曾想過學校的有趣一面.

programme.title: 返學啦老豆
programme.desc: 兩位老豆要參加比賽，陳子豐要在「扮嘢大賽」中和學生合力扮演微波爐，但同學竟然不知微波爐是何物？陳柏宇亦同樣要接受「社際大挑戰」，考記憶力和計數，他們能否勝出呢？另外，兩位老豆要挑戰做小學生的一日功課，他們能夠應付嗎.

programme.title: Bandai 呈獻: 幪面超人 ZEZTZ
聲的築城者
programme.desc: 《聲的築城者》是⼀個以香港為舞台的⽂化紀錄節⽬，透過鏡頭走訪⾳樂產業的不同⾓落，尋找那些推動香港⾳樂⽂化發展的靈魂⼈物。從舞台上光芒四射的歌⼿，到幕後默默耕耘的作曲家、填詞⼈、編曲⼈、監製，再到塑造市場與⾳樂⽅向的唱⽚公司，以及承載無數回憶的現場⾳樂表演場地──節⽬將全⾯呈現香港⾳樂⽣態背後的⼒量與故事.

programme.title: 雲端對談 第四系列
programme.desc: 香港大學外科學系講座教授（移植腫瘤學及免疫學），香港大學外科學系臨床與轉化實驗室主任，器官移植與再生實驗室主任，肝移植與肝癌實驗室主任。領先研發技術「肝立方」，透過三維生物打印仿製病患肝臟，幫助病患快速評估各類傳統藥物和新興療法的功效和副作用，幫助醫生作出精準診療決策.

programme.title: 為食家族
programme.desc: 今集管家霍哥及佩男帶他們的為食家族去品嚐非洲菜及埃及菜，到底此兩種菜色會否考起兩隊家族的飲食知識？另外，久未食過住家飯的妹妹思男，在入圍家族「飛媽造飯」的安排下體驗了人生的第一次野餐，以及感受到被關注的感動。至於入圍家族「最緊要食」則帶管家米露迪體驗了韓式裱花及品嚐豉油西餐，而米媽更被家族成員的舉動感動得眼泛淚光.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 山旮旯拯救隊在了解陳家揚除了在地方社區推動社區營造，也規劃了許多結合當地特色的旅遊行程，AV與狄達首先參加了騎單車環列嶼的行程，體驗烈嶼美好的景色，接下來協助家揚舉辦的「微醺枝葉」活動，體驗邊走邊喝當地特色高粱酒並認識當地社區特色的行程，最後晚上參加潮間帶導覽的活動，從生態面切入再更深入認識金門，最後跟家揚道別，並由這次體悟到地方社區的參與對地方創生的重要性.

programme.title: 癮營人
programme.desc: 之前提及，Creamy計劃周詳，Polly愛拖延，二人性格南轅北轍，同房一晚，Creamy就要求換房，舍監嘉盈和許賢鼓勵她們多試一晚，結果，兩個人宣佈試驗失敗，自行問准其他癮營人收留她們，並收拾房間。為訓練Polly做事效率，製作組委派她安排晚餐外賣，嘉盈形容工作人員玩「花式自殺」，許賢乾脆找東西吃，明顯投不信任票，Thomas卻挑戰Polly，要求吃雞蛋仔！究竟，大家幾點吃晚餐？吃的是甚麼呢.

programme.title: 巴絲Let’s go歐
programme.desc: 葡萄牙之旅嚟到尾聲，193為細妹郭嘉盈（Michelle）準備晚飯，為佢即將到來嘅街頭表演打氣。點知打氣變成鬥氣，一餐飯引發一場罵戰，咁點收科？Michelle終於要到著名景點公開表演，面對陌生嘅觀眾，演出表現如何呢.

programme.title: 我哋都係香港人
programme.desc: 天生風趣風岩見龍馬，是在香港土生土長的日本人，跟隨父親成為柔道教練，小時候跟香港好多的小朋友一樣，鍾意睇日本漫畫，打紅白機。雖然小時候就讀日本人學校，但可以講得一口流利的廣東話。現時除了周末教小朋友柔道外，仲擔任日本文化協會理事，在香港推廣日本文化，新年時仲會表演打年糕.

programme.title: 也文也武同學仔
programme.desc: 同學仔的創意好多都天馬行空，但如果運用在現實生活當中就好有用。就好像位於黃大仙區的天主教伍華小學，這裡的同學仔除了能歌善舞之外，還會運用創科的知識，去改變周邊的環境問題.

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: Gen Z觀察學
programme.sub-title: 最後實踐日！GenZ將創意兌換成關愛
programme.desc: 《Gen Z觀察學》嚟到最後一集，創作組兩位阿朗同Cherry代表全體GenZ，將佢哋呢代對世界嘅關注兌換成真實嘅行動，跟強尼一同認識一班堅強而積極嘅殘疾人士，發揮佢哋嘅創意，將愛化成畫作，用時間同耐心作出最真摯嘅交流，亦令他們對世界對不同世代更了解、更近一點.

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 以為面癱是冷臉耍帥？其實可能是嚴重健康警號！今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來譚玉瑛一起請教醫生！究竟面癱有什麼成因，又可能反映出什麼身體問題.

programme.title: FWD 富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 不同年代也會誕生著不同的流行曲。開心時，你會聽著某些流行曲；悲傷時，你會聽著某些流行曲，這些流行曲總伴隨著你我長成。《CHILL CLUB》透過主持駱振偉，聯同每集不同嘉賓，唱出不同年代的流行曲，重塑各個觀眾對那些流行曲的情懷及回憶。而且，每一集都會有「新歌推介」，令觀眾也可得知現時最新的流行曲.

programme.title: 人類觀察學
programme.desc: “如果我是XX，你會怎麼做？”《人類觀察學》是一個有關率直反應概念題材的節目，它採訪了大街上的素人以及名人，並利用隱藏攝像頭捕捉被觀察者的反應。例如，如果一個受歡迎的名人打扮成普通的店員會怎樣呢？或者當一個略為微醉的丈夫決定問妻子是否愛他時，會發生什麼事情？她的反應會是什麼？她又會否作出回應？在這個節目裡，人們的坦率反應屢屢超乎想像.

programme.title: 蠟筆小新
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.

programme.title: 神之調酒師
programme.desc: 賽程接近尾聲，賽事一場比一場嚴峻。只有兩人可以進入最終戰，他們將要面對大眾評審，這個回合考驗他們作為一個調酒師所需要的全面能力，究竟誰能戰到最後，奪得神之調酒師的稱號.

programme.title: 沖繩任你點
programme.desc: 常言道運氣也是實力的一種，今集透過豐富又貼心的抽獎環節和遊戲測試主持們的另類實力，到底誰是地獄黑仔王？誰又能失而復得添好運？另外，接近旅程尾聲，製作組特意安排了一餐豐富的沖繩地道高級料理慰勞主持們，席間他們會分享旅程感受.

programme.title: 手尋藝術
programme.desc: 藝術家沈君怡擅長以山水畫探討社會與時間，並破格地用銀箔演繹傳統畫作中的「虛」。今集，主持將帶大家了解她的創作意念，並跟她學習繪畫山石與貼銀箔的工序，感受傳統與當代元素碰撞出的新火花.

programme.title: 山旮旯拯救隊
programme.desc: 山旮旯拯救隊在了解陳家揚除了在地方社區推動社區營造，也規劃了許多結合當地特色的旅遊行程，AV與狄達首先參加了騎單車環列嶼的行程，體驗烈嶼美好的景色，接下來協助家揚舉辦的「微醺枝葉」活動，體驗邊走邊喝當地特色高粱酒並認識當地社區特色的行程，最後晚上參加潮間帶導覽的活動，從生態面切入再更深入認識金門，最後跟家揚道別，並由這次體悟到地方社區的參與對地方創生的重要性.

programme.title: 環保發現號
programme.desc: 結婚是人生大事，新人們都想將婚禮盡善盡美。然而牽涉的物品很多，是否通通都要用完即棄？今集嘉賓將婚禮用品循環再用，聽聽她如何減少浪費.

programme.title: 聲的築城者
programme.desc: 走進唱片發行商 James 的世界，聽他細說音樂如何在創作與市場間流轉，見證香港樂壇的起落與心血.

programme.title: 我哋都係香港人
programme.desc: 天生風趣風岩見龍馬，是在香港土生土長的日本人，跟隨父親成為柔道教練，小時候跟香港好多的小朋友一樣，鍾意睇日本漫畫，打紅白機。雖然小時候就讀日本人學校，但可以講得一口流利的廣東話。現時除了周末教小朋友柔道外，仲擔任日本文化協會理事，在香港推廣日本文化，新年時仲會表演打年糕.

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: 袁思偉，香港男子排球代表隊隊長兼二傳手，曾出戰杭州亞運。畢業體育教育系，現任小學體育科主任及排球教練，雙職並行推廣排球運動，勵志故事鼓舞年輕一代.

programme.title: 設計新態度
programme.desc: 書法字體有成千上萬種，每個人都能創造自己獨有的風格。今集主持訪問英文書法設計師，聽聽她的書法設計故事.

programme.title: 菁新力量
programme.desc: 蕭裕蓓 （bgirl Mirage）8歲時被醫生診斷為全身關節炎，並預計她18歲或會無法走路。然而，她選擇以霹靂舞挑戰宿命，最終跳出香港。今集主持將了解她背後的故事，見證她如何舞出奇蹟.

programme.title: 交易時段
programme.desc: 緊貼市場走勢，為你提供全面訊息，分析港股焦點新聞消息.

programme.title: 新年流流返乜工
programme.desc: 傳統以舞獅舞龍保祐來年風調雨順，而今年貴為「龍」年，「龍」更有吉祥及尊貴的象徵，為這項表演更添意義。今次主持芯駖前往一間經營了將近30年的紙紮鋪，首次挑戰龍頭紮作，更主動請纓參與舞龍表演的「重要角色」，經常「習舞」的芯駖首次「習武」，能否勝任舞龍表演的工作？表現又會否令人刮目相看.

programme.title: FWD富衛保險呈獻: CHILL CLUB 推介
programme.desc: 一首歌背後嘅故事、花咗好多心機嘅MV、歌手同幕後音樂人嘅心血… 《CHILL CLUB 推介》星期一至五晚一於全部都推介俾你.

programme.title: 3 分鐘熱度

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王

programme.title: 親愛壞蛋
programme.desc: 還完債務已一無所有的韓真真，帶著丈夫莊俊傑及女兒莊映文搬入姐姐的高級豪宅中暫住，打算藉此展開新生活，未料卻意外捲入社區內部的勢力之爭，看似希望的未來瞬間變調……同時力圖走出欺凌陰影的莊映文，在入住社區不久後遭到性侵，愛女心切的莊俊傑，將兇手指向同為新住戶的職棒明星姜正名，頓時輿論甚囂塵上，爆料、公審接踵而至，讓姜正名無力招架，只能在記者面前怒吼兇手不是他！到底誰才是真兇？真相究竟為何.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 申社長Project
programme.desc: 申在浩是深受愛戴的炸雞餐廳老闆，卻擁有異於常人的膽識與協商技巧，他擅長幫助他人解決糾紛。雖然他行事低調，但他的智慧和熱情卻為他贏得了鄰裡中「非正式調解員」的美譽。申在浩在幫助別人的同時發現自己過去埋藏的傷痛.

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王
programme.desc: 在華麗成功的三位朋友面前，出現一位 10 年前因她們的謊言而成為殺人犯的老朋友，她為揭開三人隱藏在假面之下的真面目而決定背水一戰。而四位老朋友也因一位男人面臨人生漩渦，彼此展開關乎嫉妒和慾望戰爭的故事.

programme.title: 親愛壞蛋
programme.desc: 還完債務已一無所有的韓真真，帶著丈夫莊俊傑及女兒莊映文搬入姐姐的高級豪宅中暫住，打算藉此展開新生活，未料卻意外捲入社區內部的勢力之爭，看似希望的未來瞬間變調……同時力圖走出欺凌陰影的莊映文，在入住社區不久後遭到性侵，愛女心切的莊俊傑，將兇手指向同為新住戶的職棒明星姜正名，頓時輿論甚囂塵上，爆料、公審接踵而至，讓姜正名無力招架，只能在記者面前怒吼兇手不是他！到底誰才是真兇？真相究竟為何.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 醫師阿修羅
programme.desc: 女急救醫生杏野朱羅(松本若菜)有著出色的醫療技術，甚至能夠同時為兩名重症患者進行高難度手術，以致被稱為「阿修羅醫生」，她從不考慮醫院的利益，亦不會顧忌上級，只會專注拯救眼前的患者，即使對方身無分文又或者是黑道成員，都堅信要絕對幫助他們.

programme.title: 綁架之日
programme.desc: 故事描繪一位除了愛什麼都不懂的笨拙綁匪與一位不懂愛的天才少女，性格迥異的命運共同體“父女”，展開一段獨特的逃亡旅程。主角新庄政宗（齋藤工）為了籌措患有心臟病女兒的手術費，在妻子的提議下，決定綁架富有的醫院院長之女七瀬凛（永尾柚乃）。新庄一直猶豫不決，但在妻子不斷策動下，他終於開車來到院長宅邸附近時，一名女孩突然衝到他的車前。千鈞一髮之際，避免了事故。當凛醒來時，卻發現她失去記憶。新庄情急之下謊稱自己是她的爸爸，從此被迫開始扮演“父親”的角色。而凛的父母已被某個神秘人物殺害，新庄也因此成為殺人嫌疑犯。然而他所綁架的凛，竟是一位能操多國語言、博學多聞、思維敏捷的天才少女。從這一刻起，原本居於主導地位的新庄反而成了凛的依靠，開始向她尋求擺脫困境的建議，兩人的關係也因此徹底逆轉。除了警方外，新庄與凛還遭到來歷不明、意圖不明的男子追擊.

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.

programme.desc: 故事描繪一位除了愛什麼都不懂的笨拙綁匪與一位不懂愛的天才少女，性格迥異的命運共同體“父女”，展開一段獨特的逃亡旅程。主角新庄政宗（齋藤工）為了籌措患有心臟病女兒的手術費，在妻子的提議下，決定綁架富有的醫院院長之女七瀬凛（永尾柚乃）。新庄一直猶豫不決，但在妻子不斷策動下，他終於開車來到院長宅邸附近時，一名女孩突然衝到他的車前。千鈞一髮之際，避免了事故。當凛醒來時，卻發現她失去記憶。新庄情急之下謊稱自己是她的爸爸，從此被迫開始扮演“父親”的角色。而凛的父母已被某個神秘人物殺害，新庄也因此成為殺人嫌疑犯。然而他所綁架的凛，竟是一位能操多國語言、博學多聞、思維敏捷的天才少女。從這一刻起，原本居於主導地位的新庄反而成了凛的依靠，開始向她尋求擺脫困境的建議，兩人的關係也因此徹底逆轉。除了警方外，新庄與凛還遭到來歷不明、意圖不明的男子追擊.

programme.title: ONE DAY~平安夜的騷動~
programme.desc: 故事講述二宮和也飾演的勝呂寺誠司，在平安夜驚醒於山下碼頭，發現眼前有具被射殺的屍體。他成了最大嫌疑人，卻對發生的一切沒有任何回憶。此時他遇上了廚師立葵時生，並要嘗試從回憶碎片中尋找破案線索。​.

programme.title: 戀愛是黑暗
programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.desc: 晴原柑九朗作為SDM本部首席代表兼氣象研究員利用智慧與知識，冒著生命危險站在最前線，保護人們的性命免受巨大氣象災害威脅，為使命奮鬥的故事。​.

programme.title: 戀愛是黑暗
programme.desc: 故事從東京發生的一連串慘烈連環殺人案展開，而案件現場讓兩名記者的命運交織在一起。設樂浩暉（志尊淳）是週刊雜誌的知名自由撰稿人，筒井萬琴則是電視台新聞節目導播（岸井雪乃），敏銳且富有正義感。兩人因追蹤同一起案件而相識，並在攜手調查的過程中逐漸被彼此吸引。然而，隨著調查的深入，浩暉的身分卻越來越可疑，他的過去與案件的關聯也逐漸浮出水面──他，究竟是無辜的旁觀者，還是那個令人聞風喪膽的連環殺人犯.

programme.title: 親愛壞蛋
programme.desc: 還完債務已一無所有的韓真真，帶著丈夫莊俊傑及女兒莊映文搬入姐姐的高級豪宅中暫住，打算藉此展開新生活，未料卻意外捲入社區內部的勢力之爭，看似希望的未來瞬間變調……同時力圖走出欺凌陰影的莊映文，在入住社區不久後遭到性侵，愛女心切的莊俊傑，將兇手指向同為新住戶的職棒明星姜正名，頓時輿論甚囂塵上，爆料、公審接踵而至，讓姜正名無力招架，只能在記者面前怒吼兇手不是他！到底誰才是真兇？真相究竟為何.

programme.title: 百次的回憶
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 申社長Project
programme.desc: 申在浩是深受愛戴的炸雞餐廳老闆，卻擁有異於常人的膽識與協商技巧，他擅長幫助他人解決糾紛。雖然他行事低調，但他的智慧和熱情卻為他贏得了鄰裡中「非正式調解員」的美譽。申在浩在幫助別人的同時發現自己過去埋藏的傷痛.

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王
programme.desc: 在華麗成功的三位朋友面前，出現一位 10 年前因她們的謊言而成為殺人犯的老朋友，她為揭開三人隱藏在假面之下的真面目而決定背水一戰。而四位老朋友也因一位男人面臨人生漩渦，彼此展開關乎嫉妒和慾望戰爭的故事.

programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 申社長Project
programme.desc: 申在浩是深受愛戴的炸雞餐廳老闆，卻擁有異於常人的膽識與協商技巧，他擅長幫助他人解決糾紛。雖然他行事低調，但他的智慧和熱情卻為他贏得了鄰裡中「非正式調解員」的美譽。申在浩在幫助別人的同時發現自己過去埋藏的傷痛.

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王
programme.desc: 在華麗成功的三位朋友面前，出現一位 10 年前因她們的謊言而成為殺人犯的老朋友，她為揭開三人隱藏在假面之下的真面目而決定背水一戰。而四位老朋友也因一位男人面臨人生漩渦，彼此展開關乎嫉妒和慾望戰爭的故事.

programme.title: 親愛壞蛋

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 于氏王后
programme.desc: 于氏王后的丈夫高句麗王突然去世給宮廷帶來一場腥風血雨。根據高句麗的群婚制度，王后必須與先王的一位弟弟結婚，于氏為了阻止對王位充滿欲望的宰相及王子們，設法在24 小時內將先王的胞弟推上王位而展開一場熱血追逐.

programme.desc: 故事背景設定在1980年代，講述100號巴士「車掌小姐」（乘務員）「煐禮」與「悰喜」的閨蜜情。「悰喜」將與「煐禮」一起奔馳在100號巴士上，用她的獨立與灑脫，書寫屬於80年代女孩的故事。她們更會與命中注定的男子在青春歲月中交織一場青澀愛戀.

programme.title: 申社長Project
programme.desc: 申在浩是深受愛戴的炸雞餐廳老闆，卻擁有異於常人的膽識與協商技巧，他擅長幫助他人解決糾紛。雖然他行事低調，但他的智慧和熱情卻為他贏得了鄰裡中「非正式調解員」的美譽。申在浩在幫助別人的同時發現自己過去埋藏的傷痛.

programme.title: DNA戀人
programme.desc: 職業為遺傳基因研究員的韓素珍十分相信基因會默默指引人的命運及人生，更認為遺傳基因隱藏著尋找真愛的秘密。在一個平安夜韓素珍和男友分手，一個人失落並醉倒街頭，卻意外把生髮水倒在婦產科醫生沈延宇身上，展開一段命運般的戀情.

programme.title: 假面的女王
programme.desc: 在華麗成功的三位朋友面前，出現一位 10 年前因她們的謊言而成為殺人犯的老朋友，她為揭開三人隱藏在假面之下的真面目而決定背水一戰。而四位老朋友也因一位男人面臨人生漩渦，彼此展開關乎嫉妒和慾望戰爭的故事.

programme.title: 美女與純情男
programme.desc: 此劇敘述年幼便出道養家的一線女演員與PD的愛情故事。女演員因母親賭博的債務及醜聞一夜之間跌落谷底。PD嘗試鼓勵她重新振作，女演員卻消失了….

programme.title: 走到月亮為止
programme.desc: 多海是魔論製菓公司疲憊不堪的營銷團隊經理，她不知道自己還能忍受這種看似毫無希望的生活多久。就在這時，一心追求經濟利益的銷售部恩尚向她提出了投資加密貨幣的大膽建議。在經歷了無數次失敗後，加密貨幣成了恩尚最後的救命稻草，也是她扭轉人生的一線希望。會計部智松把花錢等同於幸福，出於害怕被拋在後面，她衝動地加入了他們。這場賭博很快變成了加密貨幣市場跌宕起伏的過山車之旅。當放棄歌唱事業、冉冉升起的公司董事咸志宇加入他們時，不可預測的混亂局面只會加深。這三個普通工人能否中大獎，一路飛向月球.

programme.desc: 本劇以患病少女何冉在生命最後階段學習生活、情感經歷與個人成長為線，講述她在遇到有著難以釋懷過往、幾乎對未來人生失去信心的傑出園藝家蕭寒後，兩人經過一系列誤打誤撞的、溫馨浪漫的奇妙際遇後，從彼此身上尋回各自生命中最重要卻曾經缺失的部分，重拾對生活的信心和希望，也收穫刻骨銘心愛情的故事.

programme.title: 俗女養成記2 （原音版）
programme.desc: 謝盈萱等原班人馬回歸出演，天心加盟飾演新角色。 40歲的陳嘉玲從天龍國回到家鄉台南，展開人生下半場。第一件要努力的事就是靠自己的雙手，把買下的鬼屋變成家。但一開始就發生一連串意外，摔傷、被蜜蜂叮，還坐輪椅進了醫院……新的一季看陳嘉玲如何用盡全力，開始書寫另一段人生篇章.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.

programme.title: 今夜一起為愛鼓掌
programme.desc: 佳晨（楊謹華 飾）是一名很會做愛的性治療師，但仍不知道怎麼愛人。圖書館員青語（Ella陳嘉樺 飾）有著外人羨慕的婚姻和工作，卻無法跟老公阿哲做愛。一個不能做愛的女人、和一個很會做愛的女人，當她們逐漸勇於面對自我，揭開過往傷疤；在探索性的旅程中，找到愛的救贖.

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 俗女養成記2 （原音版）
programme.desc: 謝盈萱等原班人馬回歸出演，天心加盟飾演新角色。 40歲的陳嘉玲從天龍國回到家鄉台南，展開人生下半場。第一件要努力的事就是靠自己的雙手，把買下的鬼屋變成家。但一開始就發生一連串意外，摔傷、被蜜蜂叮，還坐輪椅進了醫院……新的一季看陳嘉玲如何用盡全力，開始書寫另一段人生篇章.

programme.title: 愛很美味
programme.desc: 《愛很美味》講述了三位個性迥異、特色鮮明的都市麗人，在經歷了一系列創業的艱辛，職場的壓迫，和感情的波折後，對生活、事業和愛情都有了重新的認識.

programme.title: 仿生人間
programme.desc: 2035年，與人類形象無異的仿生人由於發展過快，引發公眾的擔憂。“明眸”組織專門負責仿生人案件，組員程諾頭腦冷靜，安秋善於共情，面對仿生人不斷被害，兩人聯手揭開謎團。眾生煙火，仿生人間。人類和仿生人的命運都正在被悄悄改寫.....

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 周生如故
programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 我的人間煙火
programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 變成你的那一天
programme.desc: 《變成你的那一天》講述了頂流大明星江熠和女娛記者餘聲聲因為一次意外，身體和身份互換。兩人面對現狀只能相互指導，幫對方遮掩，因此發生了一系列逗趣搞笑的故事.

programme.desc: 消防局長宋焰（楊洋飾）和急診科醫生許沁（王楚然飾）分別十年之後重逢，青春時代的兩人因家庭反對被迫分開，再相見時，兩人都有了許多成長和改變。由於工作性質的原因，宋焰和許沁漸漸有了交集。宋焰帶領十里台的消防員們為維護人民生命財產安全而英勇奮鬥，經歷了無數次血與火的生死考驗後仍不改初心。他的堅持感染著許沁，困擾他們多年的心結也漸漸被解開。兩人克服家庭阻力，最後重新走到一起，互相鼓勵，共同進步，用各自的專長守護著這座美麗的城市.

programme.title: 她的生存之道
programme.desc: 失意的女拳手劉鹽隻身踏上異國尋母之路，憑藉著拼命想要「贏一次」的野蠻生命力，在男主角盧天馳的支持與守護下，在拳擊與美食這兩個領域都闖出自己的天地，完成了人生的逆襲.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 出島約會能否一吻定情
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.title: 亞洲新聲
programme.sub-title: 馬來西亞周深驚艷Jessie J
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.title: 海昏行 第1季
programme.desc: 講述現代失意青年王衡意外穿越到西漢，結識了神似前女友的俠女得九，並與性格開朗的王爺劉賀成為摯友；他們試圖憑藉王衡的現代思維與知識，聯手改變劉賀悲劇性的命運，並在過程中共同成長、療愈彼此.

programme.title: 雙刃
programme.desc: 以近未來科幻安全危機為背景，講述了來自狂風特勤學院的曾經師徒二人姜振和白帆，在紫晶集團中邊敵對邊掩護彼此身份，姜振為意外車禍逝去的妹妹查明真相，並與白帆一同破解控制殘疾人大腦的暗黑科技公司，幫弱者脫離險境討回公道的故事.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.sub-title: 周深劉宇寧唱小甜歌超洗腦
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.

programme.title: 味道 第三季

programme.desc: 聚焦18名來自全國一線「主廚」通過不同對戰形式挑戰各類美食命題，加深著觀眾對廚師技能、主廚職業、飲食文化的多重認知。邀請到四位餐飲界頂級大師董振祥、周曉燕、譚綺文、劉一帆，以及代表食客和經營餐飲店的演員袁弘組成評委團，從不同的角度對主廚創作進行品評，見證主廚形象的誕生.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季

programme.desc: 從蘇派美食的風味、特點出發，講述南北飲食的差異和地域性，將人對美食的創造和情感與江蘇的飲食文化緊密結合，呈現蘇派美食的獨有魅力.

programme.title: 我是隱藏款
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 我們相愛吧 第3季
programme.desc: 三對明星情侶：內地演員鄭愷與圈外女友程曉玥，台灣歌手潘瑋柏搭檔內地女主持吳昕，台灣演員明道搭檔內地女演員王鷗；還有素人情侶加入，一起修煉愛情，傳遞正能量.

programme.title: 你所不知道的水韻江蘇 第3季
programme.sub-title: 非遺客棧 開門迎客
programme.desc: 聚焦「非物質文化遺產」主題，由孟非領銜，並邀請了數位00後的非物質文化遺產研學團，一同圍繞8個主題進行深度探訪，旨在全方位、立體化地展現非物質文化遺產的深厚底蘊與時代風采.

programme.title: 也許你要戀愛了
programme.desc: 以一日為期限，將地點設定為日常生活的三大場景，邀請男女嘉賓在此相聚認識並展開進一步了解；打破戀綜常見的觀察室模式，主理人張純燁將與「助力團」蕭敬騰、大張偉、蒲熠星、蔡國慶、王耀慶面對面見證男女嘉賓們的感情升溫，陪伴他們經歷情感上的甜蜜與失落.

programme.title: 海昏行 第1季
programme.desc: 講述現代失意青年王衡意外穿越到西漢，結識了神似前女友的俠女得九，並與性格開朗的王爺劉賀成為摯友；他們試圖憑藉王衡的現代思維與知識，聯手改變劉賀悲劇性的命運，並在過程中共同成長、療愈彼此.

programme.title: 雙刃
programme.desc: 以近未來科幻安全危機為背景，講述了來自狂風特勤學院的曾經師徒二人姜振和白帆，在紫晶集團中邊敵對邊掩護彼此身份，姜振為意外車禍逝去的妹妹查明真相，並與白帆一同破解控制殘疾人大腦的暗黑科技公司，幫弱者脫離險境討回公道的故事.

programme.title: 追星星的人 第3季
programme.sub-title: 解讀星宿之謎 尋覓盛唐氣象
programme.desc: 繼續重磅集結，除了經驗豐富的 “全勤者” 吳奇隆外，新成員林峯、丁禹兮、林允、趙小棠也加入「追星團」；在「星空日記」的魔法下，將打游戲的宅男、疲憊的職場打工人和沉浸於網上沖浪的情侶帶出原有空間一路滑行到戶外，讓受困於都市生活的他們探尋星空與美好的秘密.

programme.title: 築夢啟德
programme.desc: 啟德體育園自開幕以來，迅速成為本港體育及娛樂盛事新地標；為記錄這段非凡歷程，呈現從工程啟動到盛事綻放的完整旅程，帶來從未曝光的珍貴畫面，深入幕後世界，見證團隊如何克服挑戰，打造世界級體育、音樂與文化盛事，展現香港的盛事實力，並透過「香港主場」凝聚全城.

programme.title: 傳承人 第二季
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產即某地區文化傳承有重要意義的行為或表現，如民俗、文化、信仰、傳統等各種智慧財產；為了全面展示保護的成果，推動高品質發展，節目打造以非物質文化遺產傳承為主題，令更多人認識及發揚光大.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 回溯心動軌跡 眾人淚灑現場
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.desc: A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

programme.desc: Asian Hawk (Jackie Chan) and his bumbling sidekick are sent on a quest through Europe to find a mysterious treasure held by a shadowy organization of monks.

programme.title: 告訴世界我來過
programme.desc: The 24-hour veterinary clinic acts like a bridge, witnessing the birth, separation, sickness and death of animals that human ever loved. On the contrary, also filled with our hope and despair. Some of their lives are in danger because of human's selfishness and ruthlessness. 'Once They Were Here ' tells the fate from different animals on the choice of human. Perhaps it is not pure love and random. The so-called equality of life is only reflected in the uninterrupted heartbeat.

programme.title: 聽見兩個世界
programme.desc: Dai is born to deaf parents and has been raised with deep love in rural Japan. However, as he grows older, he becomes troubled by his differences from others and begins to blame his deaf mother for his daily frustrations. When he turns 20, Dai leaves home for Tokyo as if to escape. Life in Tokyo was lonely at first, but when Dai starts working as a magazine reporter, he finds fulfillment in meeting a diverse group of people. Time eventually passes, and Dai returns home for the first time in eight years. In spending peaceful time with his deaf mother after a long time, a memory that has been sealed away unexpectedly comes back to Dai.

programme.title: 來福大酒店
programme.desc: To raise funds for his father, Sanqing, who has faced social ostracism, goes undercover at the Life Hotel near the hospital, aiming to disrupt its operations and coerce owner Xiao Lin into agreeing to its demolition. However, as they spend time together, Sanqing forms bonds with the hotel's residents and learns of the guests' life stories. His internal conflict escalates, turning a simple undercover assignment into a matter of personal integrity. The hotel's destiny impacts not only its inhabitants but also Sanqing's longing for home. Yet, his indecision triggers a deeper crisis..

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：黃子華: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit.

programme.title: 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: 迷城
programme.desc: When former cop-turned-bar owner T-man Kwok (Louis KOO) befriends a drunken woman at closing hours (TONG Liya), they soon find themselves targeted both by her former lover-a high-powered Hong Kong attorney-and the thugs (CHANG Hsiao-Chuan) he employs. Once Kwok's underachieving half-brother (Shawn YUE) and a suitcase full of tainted cash enter the picture, the chase turns deadly, with the brothers' tense family history coming to the surface as Kwok finds himself torn between the triads and his former police colleagues.

programme.title: 沖天火
programme.desc: Five years ago, a fire took the life of Professor Poon, and the notebook on his research for a cancer cure called “super stem cells” disappeared without a trace. His assistant Ko Yuk was escaped death thanks to security guard Chong Tin-po. After losing his wife to cancer several years ago, Tin-po entered “Sky Number One,” a top-level medical facility financed by the tycoons, as a security guard. He hopes that the lab will finally find a cure for cancer, but he realizes that Ko Yuk is the only researcher that is actually trying to develop “super stem cells” to save lives. Meanwhile, her husband, “Sky Number One” president Tong Wing-cheung, is a ruthless businessman who puts money ahead of everything and will take any means necessary to get his way..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -夜場三傑
programme.desc: For filming the CNY hit “Night King”, Alan Yeung, Dee Ho and Siuyea Lo personally visited nightclubs to conduct action research that were filled with countless hilarious moments and amazement in the real nightlife! Had they also been at a loss when facing Dayo Wong, Sammi Cheng and all the pretty ladies on set? In this episode, the gentlemen from “Night King” are going to unveil the nightclub's backstage and share their thoughts on collaborating with the superstars.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：百味映人生: 做個有錢人
programme.desc: Success in business, having a happy family, and being a rich one is what most people wish for. This is also the wish of the young man A Hwa! Those who are hardworking, responsible and know how to be grateful will surely be rich and become wealthy.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -歡度今晚夜
programme.desc: In this episode, “Night King” Dayo Wong and Director Jack Ng reveal their personal experiences in nightclubs. While Dayo shares his 'bitterness' of being surrounded by the ladies and unveils the intricate storylines in the film, they also discuss about the differences between “Night King” and previous nightclub movies, allowing everyone to appreciate the film from various perspectives.

programme.title: 手捲煙
programme.desc: Former Hong Kong Military Service Corps officer becomes caught in a triad manhunt when he takes in an ethnic South Asian man carrying a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live under the same roof, the two men transcend their cultural and racial differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: 攻殼機動隊
programme.desc: In the year 2029, advances in cybernetic technology allowed people to replace body parts and organs for robotic ones. Even the brain could be replaced with a cyber-brain with the ability to gain access to the internet and different networks. Major Motoko Kusanagi, a cyborg agent working for the government, and her team have been given the assignment to track down the notorious hacker known as ‘The Puppetmaster' and uncover his plans. Her mission explores the escalating synergy between humanity and technology, while questioning the very essence of sentient existence.

programme.title: 魔警
programme.desc: By a strange twist of fate, dutiful Hong Kong policeman Dave Wong saves the life of the leader of a violent gang of armed robbers. When they commit another crime, Dave is determined to put an end to their activities. He works with the leader, whom the gang had betrayed, to engineer a plan to wreak havoc within the gang and let the gangsters kill one another. But it becomes increasingly obvious to Dave and to his colleagues that Dave is suffering from a severe mental disorder, and Dave finds that instead of upholding the law as a righteous police officer, he has now become a fugitive wanted for murder.

programme.title: 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: 體驗撈金魚吧
programme.desc: Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins..

programme.title: 北京樂與路
programme.desc: Yang Yin, a starry-eyed dance girl in search of love; Ping Lu, an impetuous Beijing Rock and Roll singer in search of recognition; and Michael, a Hong Kong-born and overseas-educated composer in search of himself. Three people from different walks of life are..

programme.title: 4拍4家族
programme.desc: “Band Four” is the story of Cat aspiring to make her mark on the global music stage, while contending with the haunting absence of her father, King, a guitarist who abandoned her and her mother two decades ago. Cat's life takes a dramatic turn when her mother succumbs to illness, and King unexpectedly appears at the funeral together with Matilda, Cat's previously unknown adolescent stepsister, further complicating Cat's ongoing struggle to raise her own 9-year-old son, Riley. Forced to live together in a crowded Hong Kong flat, the newly reunited family finds itself in a vortex of conflicting personalities, insecurities, and priorities. The family finds amidst this turmoil a common communication channel via music. Just as the familial bond begins to form through their shared musical language, both their bond and Band Four's survival are put to the test by a fresh set of unforeseen challenges.

programme.title: 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taiwan and one in China. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taiwan sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from China is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 曾經擁有
programme.desc: Anyone who has anything to do with the film industry in Hong Kong, must have heard of a film buff called Lil' Kim. He knows everything there is to know about filmmaking. Whether it's on the set, at the movie premiere or at a press conference, he always shows up uninvited. Nobody knows where he came from and why he showed up... Ginger Keung is the producer of a reality show who suspects Lil' Kim is in fact a film critic who pans movies to extort advertising dollars from film companies. She zeroes in on Lil' Kim as her next target and decides to dig into his elusive past..

programme.title: 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father..

programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.

programme.title: 一個人的武林
programme.desc: A vicious killer Feng is going round Hong Kong killing top martial arts exponents, leaving a secret weapon called the Moonshadow as his calling card. When convicted killer and kung fu expert, Xia, hears of this, he offers to help the police catch the killer, in return for his freedom. Despite their misgivings, the police release the former police martial arts instructor into their custody. With his help, they realize from the chronological order of the victims that the killer is targeting his victims, all the top masters in their martial arts style, following a martial code of training. When Xia also disappears after a close encounter with Feng, they suspect the worse..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場

programme.title: 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess..

programme.title: 小心眼
programme.desc: Zhang Liang is a young man who does not engage into any proper work. His secret hobby is to play with all kinds of high-tech candid technology, especially the candid photographs. He likes to upload the photographs on the Internet to share his homepage with others. Within his beloved masterpiece, he specially falls madly in love on a young air-stewardess. One day, Zhang Liang follows the young lady Amy from the airport to Tai O. In order to catch more splendid segments, Liang brings his full equipment all the way to stay in a vacation house - Mei King Village and becomes a neighbour of Amy..

programme.title: 藉著雨點再愛你
programme.desc: Along with his young son, Ji-ho, Woo-jin misses his wife Soo-a, who died after promising to return a year later with the rainy season. Miraculously, they reunite with Soo-a when the rainy season comes around, but she has no memory of her husband and son whom she dearly loved.

programme.title: 超級無敵羊咩咩大電影之天外飛咩
programme.desc: When a visitor from beyond the stars – an impish and adorable alien called LU-LA – crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun soon sees an opportunity for alien-powered fun and adventure, and sets off on a mission to shepherd LU-LA back to her home... Little do the pair know, though, that they are being pursued at every turn by a mysterious alien-hunting government agency, spearheaded by the formidable Agent Red and her bunch of hapless, hazmat-suited goons. Can Shaun and the flock avert Farmageddon on Mossy Bottom Farm before it's too late.

credits.director: 李察菲蘭, 威爾比察

programme.title: 犯罪都市
programme.desc: Kickstarting a plan to mop up the mob in one clean sweep! 2004, Seoul. Coming from Harbin, China, JANG Chen is a new breed of gangster who single handedly takes over a mob and becomes the most feared gangster in the city. He and his merciless gang are willing to do anything it takes for money. Ruthless detective MA Seok-do wields his powerful fists to maintain peace in his city. When MA notices JANG falls his district into chaos, MA and his ragtag group of detectives form a plan to get rid of JANG and his men for good.

programme.title: 猶瑟與虎魚們
programme.desc: A fateful encounter between average college student Tsuneo and a wheelchair-bound dreamer, Josee, who spends her time reading and painting. As Tsuneo is swept up by her dreams, Josee takes another chance at facing reality.

programme.title: Laughing Gor之變節
programme.desc: Brother Laughing is supposedly an undercover police officer who has infiltrated a triad organization. During a drug-trafficking operation he is caused by Superintendent Poon. Before he became a police officer, Brother Laughing was a member of the triads and worked for the big boss man No. 1. No. 1 was very good to Laughing, and Laughing looked up to No. 1 as his elder brother. In order to strengthen his business and illegal activities, No. 1 arranges for Laughing to join the Police Force and become his mole to gather information about the plans and counter-plans for operations by the police. Laughing graduated from Police Academy with outstanding results but before he was assigned to a post as a police officer, his “bad boy” image attracted the attention of the Head of District Anti-Triad Squad, Superintendent Sin who arranges his assignment as an undercover cop to infiltrate the mob syndicate. Laughing was now a “double” mole. No. 1 was happy with this turn of events as Laug.

programme.title: 來自雪國的遺書
programme.desc: In 1945, after the end of World War II, Hatao Yamamoto was imprisoned in a concentration camp in Sibera, Russia. Despite the harsh, despairing condition in the camp, Hatao Yamamoto kept telling other prisoners not to give up hope, and that the day when they could all go back home would come. Hatao Yamamoto firmly believed that he would return to Japan and meet his wife, Mojimi Yamamoto, and their children someday. 8 years after the war, he received a postcard from his wife with a one-line message written on it, stating that “We are waiting for you to come back”. Meanwhile, Hatao Yamamoto's health was deteriorating rapidly. After having a diagnosis, the doctor told him that he had only three months left... After listening to his friends' advices, he decided to write a will and left it to his friends to bring it to his family when they were released. However, the will was seen as a spying message by the officers in the concentration camp and was confiscated..

programme.title: 三人行
programme.desc: Zhau is a young doctor who desperately needs a successful operation on a high-profile patient to redeem a previous failure which not only cost the life of a patient but her self-esteem. Han is a suspect of multiple armed robberies and homicides, who has been taken to the hospital after being shot with a bullet in his head during a showdown with the police. Officer Lok is at first sight a gung-ho policeman who has participated in the showdown, but when he makes desperate attempts to do Han in by exploiting Zhau's weaknesses, it is apparent he is harboring a much darker secret..

programme.title: 千萬別開門
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body..

programme.title: 得寵先生
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in..

programme.title: 忘不了
programme.desc: Siu Wai is widowed when her husband was killed in accident. She becomes a mini-bus driver for her living and gradually finds comfort in Dai Fai. As Dai Fai falls for Siu Wai..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場

programme.title: 葉問3
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, in Hong Kong which is under British colonial rule, Frank, a foreign property developer who colludes with the gangs and even the Police, is reclaiming houses and a school from the local community. It is not a good time for the Wing Chun master Ip Man to deal with young Bruce Lee who just applied for an apprenticeship. For the good of the people, he steps forward and re-enters the “battlefield”. In collaboration with another Wing Chun practitioner Tin Chi, Ip Man rescues the children kidnapped by the gangs..

programme.title: 惡搞野郎與美麗癲世界
programme.desc: Three members of Japanese superstar boy band SMAP propel a trio of fantastical narratives, which ultimately converge in the chaotic fourth chapter of this wildly imaginative anthology. A pianist crosses paths with a young woman running as fast as she can. Meanwhile, a musician who cannot sing encounters a girl who eats songs, while a married couple head to Okinawa in search of their son's right arm. Anarchic, energetic, wild and wonderful, this singular celebration of creativity is helmed by a quartet of equally unhinged filmmaking visionaries, resulting in an explosive cinematic carcophony.

credits.director: 園子溫, 山內健司, 太田光, 兒玉裕一

programme.title: 紮職
programme.desc: William, Derek and Edward have worked for Patrick's gang in Yaumatei since they were 16. William is educated as well as courageous. After graduating from university, a former classmate referred him to a job as a debt collector for a wealthy businessman. He very quickly makes a lot of money and forms his own team. He and the businessman's daughter Michelle are very much in love. In his dealings, he offends Angry Ming. Later, in the name of gang business, and very much against Patrick's directives, William kills Angry Ming. He did this for two reasons: one, for revenge, and two, to lay the foundation for himself to become the head of the gang. But very unexpectedly, Angry Ming's widow Irene not only fights him for the position of Dragon Head, she also wants to avenge her husband, an eye for an eye. At the same time, Michelle wants William to run away to America with her, and leave gang business behind. In the end, will William be able to leave the gang completely.

programme.title: 鬼請你睇戲
programme.desc: GV Broadway Cinema is the oldest cinema in the city and it'll be demolished soon. The cinema has always been dark and cold, so it became the last place for the ghost to stay. Yang Yang found a temporary job in the cinema. But this is the last day of his job, so he brings his girlfriend Yiu-yiu to watch the last movie, not realizing a horrible nightmare is coming..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 少年的你
programme.desc: On the cusp of China's competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: 好狗不見了Haw
programme.desc: Tamio Akanishi is a hapless public servant who has just hit the low point of his life having been dumped by his fiancee. He spends his days living alone in a big house he had bought for a married life that never materialized. At the recommendation of his concerned boss, he adopts a large white dog that had been abandoned by a previous owner who had mistreated him. The dog can only eke out a raspy whisper due to having had his vocal cords removed. Tamio names the extremely loving and trusting dog 'Haw' for the sound he makes, and thus begins the rapturously joyful life of a man and his dog.

programme.title: Laughing Gor之潛罪犯
programme.desc: To undertake the ending of TV drama “Lives of Omission”, Laughing is sentenced to life-imprisonment for killing Michael. In the prison, Laughing got to know Professor Fok, an introvert serving his sentence for drug-dealing. Professor Fok is a gifted psychologist who reads mind: discovering the deepest, darkest secrets of others, thus enabling him to manipulate and control others. Laughing learns more of psychology and he holds a strong admiration for Professor Fok. But in fact, Professor Fok has an ulterior motive. Laughing, confirming his imprisonment is all part of a new secret mission, the Security Bureau wants Laughing to infiltrate in prison to investigate further for the suspected corrupted cops..

programme.title: 衝鋒車
programme.desc: Lucifer and his gangsters dress their minibus to resemble a police vehicle, and pose as policemen for a robbery. At the robbery the gangsters engage in a gunfight against the real criminals, who kill randomly. Lucifer and his men are infuriated. They may wear police costumes and use toy guns, but their passion is real. Sensing their righteous passion, Chui decides to side with the imposters and their 16-passenger EU vehicle. Lucifer and his men re-discover the bond they felt when they used to battle together.

programme.title: 浪漫特攻隊
programme.desc: Yeo-rae is a retired national superstar in Korea. During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: 失蹤
programme.desc: In 2005, a high-profile case of a police officer who disappeared during a forest hike spawned urban legends about the existence of a gateway into another world. In 2016, those legends inspired popular internet novel Missing, which is now being adapted into an eerie supernatural thriller by first-time director and Fresh Wave alum Ronnie Chau. Former pop idol Gillian Chung stars as a social worker who hires a mountain guide to search for her missing father in the mountains. She discovers the mystical gateway from the urban legends, but is her father really waiting for her on the other side.

programme.title: 拳霸無銀用
programme.desc: Thongpoon wants to produce a movie by using his gift of martial art to be a leading actor. Without money, he joins a boxing gambling for finding funds, but at last he becomes a prizefighter unexpectedly.

programme.title: 劍雨
programme.desc: In 428AD, Bodhi, Prince of Southern India, becomes a Buddhist monk and sets off for China, earning a hallowed reputation as a mystical martial artist. Following his death, his remains mysteriously disappear. It is rumored that his remains contain the secret to obtaining limitless power and ruling the martial arts world. Centuries later, The Dark Stone emerges as a team of deadly assassins; their best assassin is the ruthless, invincible Drizzle. On her latest mission, Drizzle takes out Zhang Haiduan, a high-ranking court official. Zhang's son, Renfeng, while mourning his father's death, is also attacked and seemingly killed by Drizzle and her fellow assassins. Drizzle's life changes when she kills Lu Zhu, a monk with whom she has unintentionally fallen in love..

programme.title: 醬園弄．懸案
programme.desc: Set in a bustling alleyway during the Japanese occupation of Shanghai in the 1940s, the film centres on a wife, Zhan Zhou, who was being charged with the bloody dismemberment of her husband – a killing that seems impossible for her to have committed alone. The murder thrusts Zhan into the spotlight and the court of public opinion, forcing her towards a fate intertwined with that of her own country.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -「港」笑研究所
programme.desc: Hong Kong comedies from the 1980's and 1990's had been widely popular and many of them are still considered as classics among the genre. In this episode, the “Humor Research Institute” has invited veteran filmmakers Chan Hing Kai, Ho Miu Ki and Jack Ng to talk about their comedy-creating experience and introduce how fascinating comedies are written.

programme.title: 大隻佬
programme.desc: Bodybuilder and striper Biggie can see into people's past lives. He meets rookie cop Yee and help her track down criminals. Yee decides to help him back while Biggie decides to.....

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -夜場三傑
programme.desc: For filming the CNY hit “Night King”, Alan Yeung, Dee Ho and Siuyea Lo personally visited nightclubs to conduct action research that were filled with countless hilarious moments and amazement in the real nightlife! Had they also been at a loss when facing Dayo Wong, Sammi Cheng and all the pretty ladies on set? In this episode, the gentlemen from “Night King” are going to unveil the nightclub's backstage and share their thoughts on collaborating with the superstars.

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal..

programme.title: 寄了一整個春天
programme.desc: Ching, a high school girl who wants to fall in love but feels isolated due to being born with a stutter, runs an online business with Rachel, her only friend. Ching unexpectedly gains the attention and love of buyers. As she submerges herself in this unethical business, Ching believes she has found true love. However, she is unaware that she has lost her only friendship.

programme.title: 幽靈人間II鬼味人間
programme.desc: Jack is laden with ominous anxiety the moment he and his bride Ching step into the new apartment they recently purchase at a suspiciously low price. For one thing, his new neighbors are not only unfriendly but downright creepy. Notwithstanding Jack's miraculous recovery from a near fatal accident by a hit-and-run driver outside his building, everything starts going downhill from this point forward. On the one hand, the image of a gruesome female cadaver pops in and out of Jack's vision whenever he sneezes. On the other, Ching starts behaving most bizarrely, as if she is being possessed..

programme.title: 革命者
programme.desc: It tells the tale of Li Da Zhao's revolutionary deeds from 1912 to 1927, and the stories of human beings with lofty beliefs and innovative pioneers underneath his management who devoted themselves to the awesome cause of Marxism.

programme.title: 緊急迫降
programme.desc: Veteran chief police detective In-ho (SONG Kang-ho) receives a tip about a man threatening a terrorist attack against a plane. While investigating, he discovers that the suspect has actually boarded flight no. KI501. Despite his phobia of flying, Jae-hyuk (LEE Byung-hun) decides to go to Hawaii for the sake for his daughter's health. At the airport, he is distracted by a strange man who hangs around, speaking to them in a menacing way. Flight no. KI501 departs Incheon Airport for Hawaii, but soon afterwards a man dies for mysterious reasons. Fear and chaos spread quickly, not only inside the plane, but also on land. Hearing this news, Transport Minister Sook-hee (JEON Do-yeon) sets up a counterterrorism task force and calls an emergency meeting in order to find a way to land the airplane.

programme.title: 惡行之外
programme.desc: One rainy night, the dead body of a girl, the only daughter of Hong Kong police Yin Lok, is found in the wild. Polices based on clues, suspect has been identified. However, several more girls are murdered and murder cases keep happening. Yin begins to investigate his daughter's death and met a mentally retarded girls, he is looking for more clues from this special girl. Finally, Yin is getting closer to the truth..

programme.title: 春心萌動的老屋緣廊
programme.desc: Age is just a number when it comes to being a BL fan! 75-year-old widow Yuki (Nobuko Miyamoto) picks up a boys' love manga one day and it opens her eyes to a new world. At the bookstore, she meets shy 17-year-old schoolgirl Urara (Mana Ashida) who reads BL on the sly. Happily reading and discussing BL together, they forge a congenial bond that heals loneliness and unlocks their inner hopes and fears. Seasoned TV director Shunsuke Kariyama (Love's in Sight) and screenwriter Yoshikazu Okada (The 8-Year Engagement) adapt Kaori Tsurutani's award-winning manga into a heartwarming, female-centric human drama about an unlikely friendship that inspires comfort and change.

programme.title: 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman..

programme.desc: WARM HUG is a romance-comedy revolving around a boy with OCD and is not interested in both friendship and love. However, after meeting a unique doctor and a carefree girl, the three of them slowly learn and understand one another along the way..

programme.title: 誠實選舉媽 2
programme.desc: After failing to win the Seoul mayoral election, Joo Sang-sook became an unemployable property and no parties will admit to associating with her in fear of bad press, but when she rescues a young man from drowning, she is suddenly pulled into spotlight and wins the election to become the Gangwon province governor. But her honesty sinks her approval rating and she resorts back to lying through her teeth. As fate would have it, her truth mouth returns! Not only that, her chief of staff Hee-cheol is cursed with the same truth bomb.

programme.title: 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil in Greater China, John Fok.

programme.title: 臨時決鬥
programme.desc: “CHUNG LUI SOCIETY” is a boxing gym founded by the former legendary Muay Thai champion CHUNG Lui, who is dedicated to training professional fighters. Despite the gym's struggles, he remains committed to his lifelong philosophy of never backing down from a challenge. Businesswoman Elsa discovers that her boyfriend Daniel is cheating on her with Macau's female champion, Surewin. Driven by her competitive spirit, Elsa vows to settle their score in the ring. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. There, she encounters MOK Ka Lei, who had previously clashed with her during an advertisement shoot. After leaving the entertainment industry to support her family, Ka Lei attempts to make a comeback, with the help of her friend LAM Pik Chu. Under the rigorous training of Lui's protege, KO Chau, Elsa undergoes intense preparation. Alth.

Smash-head is a CID officer. Wracked by insecurity he believes the world will be destroyed by pollution. That's why he's an environmentalist. Carmen is a child psychologist. She specializes in hypnotism, her world is full of grace and vitality. That's why she believes in love. The two meet during a police chase. When Smash-head kills a hostage he mistakes as a kidnapper, he is put under internal investigation. And his superior tries to drag him into a corrupt syndicate. With no way out, he turns to Carmen. Under hypnotism, he remembers his long forgotten past and the image he had of himself as a young and enthusiastic fighter for justice. Holding on to this memory and the love of Carmen, he takes his pistol, number 9413..
